page.overview:
Who is Fairchild Family?

The Fairchild family in Fazbear Frights comprises the relatives of Danny Fairchild from the tenth book's Sea Bonnies story.

At one point, Rory plans to have a “swing-off” with Danny during recess.

When Mott is in need of a distraction for Rory to dispose of the Sea Bonnies, Danny and his mother conveniently arrive to ask Rory if he wants to join them on Dapuppy’s first leashed walk.

Mr. Fairchild recently got Danny a puppy. Mr. Fairchild kept asking, “Where’s da puppy?” which led to the puppy being named that. Afterward, Danny bugs them to get a kitten to name in a similar manner.
